item.title: Once Upon A Time In Bangalore on Chicago: Get Tickets Now! | Theatermania -
item.description: "Once Upon a Time in Bangalore" is a long-form improv comedy show inspired by over-dramatic commercial Bollywood movies. The show recreates a typical "masala" movie; but it's done all on the spot with the audience deciding the narrative. It's going to have everything – a mother's tears, childhood romance, villainous gangsters, and nonsensical songs. Never before, never after, this is a movie that you'll never forget! Starring: Avinash Ratnam Vaishakh Dutt Vishnu Raviprasad
